# The Dragonbane fixtures as a deck

Every card note in this folder, grouped in the order `card-type:` lists
them — the cover sheet first, because it is listed first. The creature card
type prints `large` on its own; a deck is one grid, so `card-size:` here
puts every card on poker.

```cardsmith-deck
system: dragonbane
card-type: [generic, gear, creature, rule, roll-table]
card-size: poker
paper-size: A4 portrait
```
